Name: Tego's Stardew Expansion Redux
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
The currently hidden mod from 2016-very early 2019 which is featured is a DangerouslyFunny video and possibly others, is back! Converted to work with stardew valley 1.5.4 using TMXLoader and ContentPatcher.

[b]The original mod was made by tegobash, I didn't make any of the assets in this mod. I did however get permission to update his mod.

 [/b]Join the discord server for support:  [url=https://discord.com/invite/6rfTxwc5bF]Discord[/url]﻿.

This mod is not finished, custom content is coming! [SPOILER] Including pink animals hehe [/SPOILER]


[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820?tab=files]TMXLoader[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]
2. Download this mod from the 'Files' Tab.
3. Unzip the zip file into your mods folder.
4. Run SMAPI!

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
Stardew Expansion was an expansion mod of stardew valley that originally got released in 2016 and got hidden in 2019. It offers quite a few maps, including a town which has a diner a joja shop and more, but it is sadly not in the version of the mod that I have right now. The current version of the mod mainly adds maps that are just outdoor maps.
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
CustomFarmMap: Do you want stardew expansions's farm map? False will remove the warp from Hills and add a busstop2/3 warp in the busstop (should be out of the way)
SecretWoodsEdit: If false, doesn't edit the secret woods and changes the warp to be in the Forest.
